header.function_name: XD06 IF Cross Dock Master to GTOPAS

objective: To send the cross dock master of every Active part waiting for synchronisation to GTOPAS as an interface file by SFTP: Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day and Effective Start Date from the Part List (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE) and all destinations with Case/Day of the ongoing period from the Part Mapping per Destination (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST).
Business purpose: GTOPAS (customer order side): which part and destination orders are handled by crossdock (order status 7) and how many cases per day per destination (assumption, TBC).
A part is sent as one complete set; GTOPAS replaces the data of the part, so a change such as Philippines up and Thailand down, or a removed destination, arrives as one consistent update.
The send status per part is kept in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT (dummy table); together with XD07 (AP POLE) it gives the overall Sync Status shown on the Cross Dock Part Master screen (XD01).

nodes.label: Send status per part, overall Sync Status, history

steps: [Sync] on XD01 sets the parts to Waiting (SYNC_STATUS = '3' in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE, IF_STATUS = '3' for 'GTOPAS' and 'APPOLE' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT) and starts XD06. Write LOG1.
Select the parts with TARGET_SYSTEM = 'GTOPAS' and IF_STATUS = '3' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT whose PART_STATUS is still 'Active'. Keep CHANGED_DT of each part. No part: write LOG2 and exit.

steps.text: Create the interface file XD_CDMASTER_GTOPAS_<YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>.csv in the outbound folder (see Interface File / Interface Data):
children: Per part: PART_NO, CROSSDOCK_FLAG 'Y', PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.
Per destination of the ongoing period: PERIOD, DEST_CODE, CASE_DAY from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST (one record each).
Same SEND_ID and SEND_DT on every record; trailer with the record count (TBC). Error: LOG3, all parts Failed (step 6).

steps.text: Put the file by SFTP to the inbound folder of GTOPAS and verify the transfer (file size / record count).
children: Transfer error: retry (parameter); still failing: LOG4.
Transfer OK: move the local file to the backup folder.

steps.text: Set the send status of every part of the file in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT:
children: Transfer OK: IF_STATUS = '1', IF_DT = now, IF_FILE_NAME = file name, IF_MESSAGE blank.
File or transfer error: IF_STATUS = '2', IF_DT = now, IF_MESSAGE = error (LOG3 / LOG4).
TBC: if GTOPAS returns a result / acknowledge file, the status per part is taken from it instead of the transfer result.

steps.text: Update the overall Sync Status of each part in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and record the history:
children: CHANGED_DT differs from step 2 (part changed while sending): SYNC_STATUS = '0' (No Sync).
Else, status of 'GTOPAS' and of 'APPOLE' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT: one still '3' -> SYNC_STATUS stays '3'; both '1' -> '1' (Success); one '2' -> '2' (Failed, SYNC_MESSAGE = target + reason).
SYNC_DT = now when SYNC_STATUS becomes 1 or 2.
Insert TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE: event SYNC, source IF, FIELD_NAME SYNC_STATUS, REMARK = 'GTOPAS: ' + result / message.

steps: Write LOG2 with the file name and the number of parts / records sent. Exit.

items: The D/S team maintains the cross dock master on XD01 (Part List: Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Effective Start Date; Mapping per Destination: Case/Day per destination of the ongoing period, created by XD05 process 2 and adjusted by screen or upload XD03).
Every change sets the part to No Sync. The D/S team clicks [Sync] when the changes are complete; only Active parts are sent, Candidate and Inactive parts are not.

XD06 sends to GTOPAS; XD07 sends the same data to AP POLE. Purpose for GTOPAS: GTOPAS (customer order side): which part and destination orders are handled by crossdock (order status 7) and how many cases per day per destination (assumption, TBC).
GTOPAS replaces the cross dock master of every part in the file with the content of the file (all destinations of the part).
Fields, source and business rule: see Interface Data (General Description). The field names on the side of the target are TBC (target layout).
Sum of CASE_DAY of the records of a part = MAX_CASE_DAY (guaranteed by XD05 and the save checks of XD01 / XD03).
PERIOD is always the ongoing period; past periods are never sent.
TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT is a dummy table that keeps the send status per part and target; the real output of XD06 is the interface file sent to GTOPAS.

Overall SYNC_STATUS: Waiting while a target is Waiting, Success when both targets are sent, Failed when one target failed (the next [Sync] sends the part again to both targets; replace is repeatable).
A part changed on XD01 or by upload while it is being sent gets SYNC_STATUS = No Sync, so the newer data is sent by the next [Sync].
SFTP topology (server, folders, user), file format / naming and whether the target returns a result file.
Field names and lengths required by the target; part without destination.
Parts that became Inactive (XD05) are not sent today: should the target receive CROSSDOCK_FLAG 'N' to stop crossdock?

tables.name: TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT
tables.description: Dummy table (proposed): send status of the cross dock master per part and target system (XD06 GTOPAS, XD07 AP POLE). The real output is the interface file sent by SFTP to the target. The overall Sync Status of the part stays in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.
columns: Calculation period of the mapping sent (YYYYMM)
Date-time of the result of the target system
Name of the interface file sent by SFTP
Reason when Failed; blank when Success
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: Candidate part setting, one record per part (Part List data, no calculation period). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Minimum MAD (mandatory); reference compared with the MAD result of the calculation
Effective start date; required while the part is Candidate
Date-time of the last IF function result
Reason of the last Failed sync
Upload that last changed the record
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST
tables.description: Destination mapping, one record per part, calculation period and destination (Mapping per Destination data). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Calculation period, YYYYMM e.g. 202609; displayed as Sep 2026
Destination code (buyer code + PD code, 7 digits); exists in TB_M_H0125_DESTINATION (Destination Master)
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: History of every change of a crossdock part (Add / Edit by screen or upload, mapping changes, Sync results, status changes and mappings made by the calculation batches). Read by the History setting modal of Part List (index PART_NO, CREATED_DT). Proposed retention: 24 months online by CREATED_DT; a monthly housekeeping job deletes older records (period configurable in system master). To be confirmed.
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM for MAPPING / SYNC / CALC; NULL for ADD / EDIT (Part List has no period)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, CASE_DAY, SYNC_STATUS
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
Free text, e.g. SYNC_MESSAGE of a Failed sync
User who made the change (IF batch user ID for SYNC, batch user ID for BATCH)
Date and time of the change
